name: Awaji (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Awaji city emblem in blue: a stylised letter A-shaped device with a pointed top.
history: Municipal flag of Awaji, a city in Hyōgo Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 April 2005.

features.role: Awaji city emblem — a stylised letter A-shaped device with a pointed top
